title: Jobs admin CLI: list, history, run now

user_story.i_want: to list jobs, see recent runs and trigger a job immediately
user_story.so_that: I don't wait for cron while developing

description: Commands: `stratum-cli jobs list` (name, schedule, next fire), `stratum-cli jobs history <name> --limit 20`, and `stratum-cli jobs run <name>`, which runs the same Job implementation in-process and respects the advisory lock. To share job code between binaries, the scheduler crate exposes a library target.

acceptance_criteria.then: every job prints with its next fire time
the latest runs print newest first

acceptance_criteria.given: the scheduler is currently running a job
acceptance_criteria.when: I run `jobs run` for that job
acceptance_criteria.then: the CLI refuses because the lock is held

rust_concepts: A crate with both lib and bin targets
